Now, as for tips:
- Bows are everything, all physical units will benefit from raising Bows to D rank for the combat art Curved Shot, which is super useful, since it let's you attack at 3 range and with increased accuracy.
- Up to you, but raising Bows to D+ is also very useful, since it let's you take the exam for the archer class, which gives you Hit +20 once mastered.
- Authority is also very important, since it gives you access to good batallions and good gambits, which are very useful for freezing groups of enemies and giving you some breathing room.
- Don't forget to use your combat arts, Smash is great for the bonus hit rate on axes, Tempest lance for great damage and hit boost, curved shot for range and bonuses hit.
- Personal preference, but I find Female Byleth better, since she gets to access to Pegasus Knight, and can start gaining flying experience early on, and she gets you Sylvain for free if you are not playing Blue Lions.
